description: This file defines the `ProjectActivity` entity class for the OrangeHRM project. It models a project activity with properties such as ID, associated project, deletion status, name, and related timesheet items. It includes ORM annotations for database mapping and uses a decorator trait.

classes.name: ProjectActivity
classes.description: Entity class representing a project activity within the ORM framework, including properties like ID, project reference, name, deletion status, and related timesheet items. It employs a decorator pattern and ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the project activity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the project activity.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with this activity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the activity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deleted status of the activity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the activity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the activity.
